_help.user: GitHub login (required). Used for URLs, avatar fallback, snake + stats endpoints.
_help.name: Display name for hero, neofetch, about.
_help.alias: Short nickname/brand. Hero title bar is <first-name>@<alias>; masthead kicker is <ALIAS> / <LOCATION>.
_help.handle_prompt: Prompt shown in neofetch + heatmap, e.g. "neo@github". Default <user>@github.
_help.tagline: One line: hero `cat role.txt` output, masthead subtitle, neofetch Role (unless role is set).
_help.role: Optional short role for neofetch (≤26 chars shown). Falls back to tagline.
_help.location: City, country. Hero top-right, masthead kicker, neofetch, about.
_help.about: Optional list of plain-text about bullets; replaces the derived ones when non-empty.
_help.links: Socials row: linkedin/x/website URLs, email address. Empty strings are skipped. links.terminal = URL of the Pages terminal, if built; adds About bullet, footer link and makes the stack icons open it with ?cmd=stack.
_help.stack: Tech names, in order. First 3 go into hero/masthead/neofetch; all go to the skillicons row.
_help.projects: Ordered; first 3 are featured (hero ls, masthead highlight, neofetch Building). owner defaults to user; demo enables Playwright thumbs; description overrides the repo description; shot_lines overrides the SVG thumb text (3-4 lines; '$ ' = command, '✓' = check, last line gets a cursor).
_help.frames: PNG paths (transparent bg) for render-ascii.py. Empty → ask the user; fallback https://github.com/<user>.png.
_help.theme: "dark" or "light" = that theme's assets only; "both" = <picture> dark/light for hero, ascii, neofetch, heatmap and stats (render each with --theme dark and --theme light).
_help.sections: hero: session|masthead|none · heatmap: square|glyph|none · stats: none|hosted (hosted endpoints are unreliable) · snake needs templates/snake.yml · the rest are booleans.
_help.ascii: render-ascii.py knobs: cols/rows of the grid, row = seconds per typed row, hold = seconds each frame stays.
